projectEdit.categories.zh-Hans: 路线类别编号，以逗号分隔

projectEdit.categoriesHint.en: Enter verified category IDs. The category picker is not connected yet.
projectEdit.categoriesHint.zh-Hans: 请输入已核实的类别编号。类别选择器尚未接入。

projectEdit.dateFormat.en: Use YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm. Times stay in the source service's local-time format.
projectEdit.dateFormat.zh-Hans: 请输入 YYYY-MM-DD 或 YYYY-MM-DD HH:mm。时间按原服务的本地时间格式保留。

projectEdit.chapterCarryOver.en: Existing artwork, audio, atmosphere and merchant terms are preserved. Editing those settings is not connected yet.
projectEdit.chapterCarryOver.zh-Hans: 已有图片、音频、配色及商家条款均会保留。这些设置的编辑尚未接入。

projectEdit.storyFlowHint.en: Use Edit to reorder blocks. Removing a stop block also removes that stop. Empty audio placeholders are omitted from the review payload.
projectEdit.storyFlowHint.zh-Hans: 点“编辑”可调整顺序。删除节点块会同时删除该节点。空音频占位不会进入待提交内容。

projectEdit.coordinatesHint.en: Enter verified coordinates. Map search is not connected; zero coordinates are invalid under the source rules.
projectEdit.coordinatesHint.zh-Hans: 请输入已核实的坐标。地图搜索尚未接入；原规则不接受零坐标。

projectEdit.gameplayDeferred.en: Existing gameplay stays attached. Creating, selecting and editing gameplay templates is not connected yet.
projectEdit.gameplayDeferred.zh-Hans: 已有玩法关联会保留。创建、选择和编辑玩法模板尚未接入。

projectEdit.priceHint.en: Enter 0 for a free ticket. Leaving this blank is not a free ticket. Currency follows the source service; no conversion is performed.
projectEdit.priceHint.zh-Hans: 免费票请填写 0。留空不代表免费。币种沿用原服务，不进行换算。

projectEdit.ticketScopeHint.en: Ticket mode follows the route type. Existing sale windows and meeting coordinates are preserved.
projectEdit.ticketScopeHint.zh-Hans: 票种模式随路线类型同步。已有售票窗口与集合坐标会保留。

projectEdit.advancedPreserved.en: Existing ownership, collaborators, self-play, rewards, media and commerce settings are preserved. Those advanced editors are not connected yet.
projectEdit.advancedPreserved.zh-Hans: 已有归属、合作者、自玩、奖励、媒体及商业设置均会保留。高级编辑功能尚未接入。

projectEdit.reviewHint.en: Review this frozen copy before continuing.
projectEdit.reviewHint.zh-Hans: 继续前请检查这份内容快照。

projectEdit.fixtureNotice.en: Synthetic editing demo. All data and outcomes are simulated; nothing is uploaded or published.
projectEdit.fixtureNotice.zh-Hans: 模拟编辑演示。所有数据及结果均为模拟，不上传、不发布。

projectEdit.unconfigured.en: Publishing is not connected. You can edit and save a local draft; nothing will be sent.
projectEdit.unconfigured.zh-Hans: 发布服务尚未接入。你可以编辑并保存本机草稿，不会发送任何内容。

projectEdit.simulated.en: Simulation completed. No project was published.
projectEdit.simulated.zh-Hans: 模拟已完成，没有发布任何项目。

projectEdit.signIn.en: Sign in to save an account-scoped draft. Unsaved guest edits stay on this screen only.
projectEdit.signIn.zh-Hans: 登录后可保存当前账号的本机草稿。游客未保存的编辑仅保留在当前页面。

projectEdit.restoreAvailable.en: A draft for this account is available. Restore it or discard it before editing.
projectEdit.restoreAvailable.zh-Hans: 找到当前账号的草稿。请先恢复或丢弃，再继续编辑。

projectEdit.localSaved.en: Draft saved on this device only.

projectEdit.localFailed.en: Local draft storage is unavailable. Your changes have not been confirmed saved.
projectEdit.localFailed.zh-Hans: 本机草稿存储不可用，尚未确认保存当前改动。

projectEdit.memberMismatch.en: The stored draft belongs to another account or deployment and cannot be opened.
projectEdit.memberMismatch.zh-Hans: 草稿属于其他账号或服务环境，无法打开。

projectEdit.incompatible.en: This saved draft is incompatible with this editor. It has not been applied.
projectEdit.incompatible.zh-Hans: 此草稿与当前编辑器不兼容，未载入。

projectEdit.revisionConflict.en: The server revision changed. Reload the current project; the old local draft will not overwrite it.
projectEdit.revisionConflict.zh-Hans: 服务端版本已变化。请重新加载当前项目；旧本机草稿不会覆盖新版本。

projectEdit.discardHint.en: This removes the saved draft on this device. It does not change the published project.
projectEdit.discardHint.zh-Hans: 此操作删除本机保存的草稿，不会改变已发布项目。

projectEdit.whitelistHint.en: This route is already on sale. Only text, images and categories can change. Dates, chapters and tickets are locked.
projectEdit.whitelistHint.zh-Hans: 路线已过审开卖，仅可修改文案、图片及类别。日期、章节和票务已锁定。

projectEdit.lockedFields.en: Locked or identity fields changed. Reload and review a fresh copy.
projectEdit.lockedFields.zh-Hans: 锁定字段或归属发生变化，请重新加载并检查。

projectEdit.invalid.en: Some required fields need attention. Nothing has been sent.
projectEdit.invalid.zh-Hans: 仍有必填项未完成，没有发送任何内容。

projectEdit.unknown.en: The previous outcome is unknown. Editing and repeat submission are locked. Checking a terminal receipt will not repeat the submission.
projectEdit.unknown.zh-Hans: 上次操作结果未知，已锁定编辑和重复提交。检查终态凭据不会再次提交。

projectEdit.rejected.en: The simulated request was rejected. No success was reported.
projectEdit.rejected.zh-Hans: 模拟请求被拒绝，未报告成功。

projectEdit.notSent.en: The request was not sent. Review again before trying.
projectEdit.notSent.zh-Hans: 请求未发送，请重新检查后再尝试。

projectEdit.preflightFailed.en: The final check or durable intent save failed. No new submission was started.
projectEdit.preflightFailed.zh-Hans: 最终检查或提交凭据保存失败，没有发起新提交。

projectEdit.loadFailed.en: The project or secure draft could not be loaded. Retry before editing.
projectEdit.loadFailed.zh-Hans: 无法加载项目或安全草稿，请重试后再编辑。

projectEdit.capabilityBlocked.en: Publishing permission or available quota does not allow this new route.
projectEdit.capabilityBlocked.zh-Hans: 当前发布权限或剩余配额不允许新建此路线。

projectEdit.mediaDeferred.en: Reference text only. Media picking, uploading and preview are not connected.
projectEdit.mediaDeferred.zh-Hans: 仅编辑引用文本。媒体选择、上传与预览尚未接入。

projectEdit.validation.categories.en: Choose at least one valid category.
projectEdit.validation.categories.zh-Hans: 请填写至少一个有效类别编号。

projectEdit.validation.dates.en: Enter a valid date or date and time.
projectEdit.validation.dates.zh-Hans: 请填写有效的日期或日期时间。

projectEdit.validation.dateOrder.en: End time must follow start time.
projectEdit.validation.dateOrder.zh-Hans: 结束时间必须晚于开始时间。

projectEdit.validation.deadline.en: Free exploration needs a recruitment deadline.
projectEdit.validation.deadline.zh-Hans: 自由探索需填写招商截止日期。

projectEdit.validation.story.en: Write a real opening story before adding city-orientation stops.
projectEdit.validation.story.zh-Hans: 城市定向需先完成本章剧情，再添加节点。

projectEdit.validation.nodes.en: Each chapter needs at least one stop.
projectEdit.validation.nodes.zh-Hans: 每章至少需要一个节点。

projectEdit.validation.blocks.en: A chapter can contain at most 200 story blocks.
projectEdit.validation.blocks.zh-Hans: 每章最多 200 个内容块。

projectEdit.validation.references.en: A story block has a missing or duplicate stop reference.
projectEdit.validation.references.zh-Hans: 故事流存在缺失或重复的节点引用。

projectEdit.validation.media.en: An image block needs a reference.

projectEdit.validation.coordinates.en: Each stop needs usable nonzero coordinates.
projectEdit.validation.coordinates.zh-Hans: 每个节点都需要有效的非零坐标。

projectEdit.validation.nodeName.en: Enter a name for every stop.
projectEdit.validation.nodeName.zh-Hans: 请填写每个节点的名称。

projectEdit.validation.merchant.en: Preserved merchant terms need valid category, mode, quota and benefit values.
projectEdit.validation.merchant.zh-Hans: 保留的商家条款需要有效的品类、模式、名额与权益值。

projectEdit.validation.price.en: Enter a nonnegative ticket price; use 0 for free.
projectEdit.validation.price.zh-Hans: 请填写非负票价，免费请填 0。

projectEdit.validation.meeting.en: City-orientation tickets need a meeting point.
projectEdit.validation.meeting.zh-Hans: 城市定向票需填写集合地点。

projectEdit.remoteEditDeferred.en: Editing existing server projects is not connected yet. Project previews remain available in My Projects.
projectEdit.remoteEditDeferred.zh-Hans: 服务端已有项目的编辑尚未接入。仍可在“我的项目”查看预览。

projectEdit.acknowledged.zh-Hans: 服务器已确认收到此次提交。

projectEdit.confirmLiveHint.en: Submit these exact changes to the server. A lost response will stay locked to prevent duplicate submission.
projectEdit.confirmLiveHint.zh-Hans: 将这些更改提交至服务器。若回执丢失，将保留锁定以避免重复提交。

projectEdit.validation.rewards.en: Check self-play price, quota and reward coupon ID.
projectEdit.validation.rewards.zh-Hans: 请检查自玩票价格、数量及奖励券 ID。

projectEdit.completion.readOnly.en: This configuration contains unsupported or unreadable rules. It is preserved unchanged; edit it in the original professional publisher.
projectEdit.completion.readOnly.zh-Hans: 此配置含不支持或无法读取的规则，保持原样；请在原专业发布页编辑。

projectEdit.completion.atLeast.en: Complete at least the specified count

projectEdit.completion.serverConditions.en: Edit nine cells in S order. The server decides when each cell is lit; labels do not change conditions.
projectEdit.completion.serverConditions.zh-Hans: 按 S 形编辑九格；点亮条件由服务端判定。名称仅改变展示，不改变条件。

projectEdit.completion.label.en: Cell label (optional, up to 24 UTF-16 units)
projectEdit.completion.label.zh-Hans: 格子名称（可留空，最多24字）

projectEdit.completion.couponHint.en: Use an existing numeric reward coupon ID. The server checks eligibility; this does not issue a coupon.
projectEdit.completion.couponHint.zh-Hans: 只填现有奖励券的数字 ID；有效性与发放资格由服务端复核，不会立即发券。

projectEdit.completion.invalidCount.en: Required completion count must be a positive integer.
projectEdit.completion.invalidCount.zh-Hans: 至少完成数量须为正整数。

projectEdit.completion.invalidCells.en: Bingo must contain exactly nine cells.
projectEdit.completion.invalidCells.zh-Hans: 九宫格必须正好包含9格。

projectEdit.completion.invalidLength.en: Cell labels allow 24 UTF-16 units and reward feedback 120.
projectEdit.completion.invalidLength.zh-Hans: 格子名称最多24字，奖励反馈最多120字。

projectEdit.completion.invalidCoupon.en: Reward coupon ID must be a nonnegative integer or blank.
projectEdit.completion.invalidCoupon.zh-Hans: 奖励券 ID 须为非负整数，或留空。

projectEdit.completion.rewardRequired.en: Add a coupon or reward feedback to at least one cell.
projectEdit.completion.rewardRequired.zh-Hans: 至少给一格配置奖励券或奖励反馈。

projectEdit.completion.invalidSource.en: Original rules changed. Reload this theme.
projectEdit.completion.invalidSource.zh-Hans: 原始规则已变更，请重新载入主题。

projectEdit.completion.tooManyNodes.en: Required completion count exceeds the configured station count.
projectEdit.completion.tooManyNodes.zh-Hans: 所需通关数量不能超过已配置站点总数。

projectEdit.completion.tooLarge.en: Completion rule configuration must not exceed 16 KiB.
projectEdit.completion.tooLarge.zh-Hans: 通关规则配置不能超过16 KiB。
